descriptionInUI: Runtime for the 'Neutral-faction border defense' setting. Inert unless the mission generator emits dcsRetribution.neutralBorder (the setting is on and the map has border zones -- they ship with the eight real-world terrains). A country with no coalition airfield inside it scrambles an alert flight against any aircraft inside their border polygon below the altitude floor: the flight spawns on the intruder's opposing coalition at return-fire, shadows, and radio-warns. The radio warning is immediate on entry; the flight launches after the dwell. A player who stays past the engage timer, releases a weapon inside the border, or fires on the shadower is engaged -- and the field's SAM battery wakes. AI intruders are shadowed only, never engaged. Spawned alert units are free, untracked event content.
